annotations.title: Read the internal notes on a chat

description: Lists the internal notes on one conversation, named by id, one page at a time, oldest first: each note’s body, its author, the members it mentions and when it was written or edited. The customer does not see notes. Notes can quote customers and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: list_chat_notes
title: Read the internal notes on a chat
